diagnostic_plan.convergence: must converge without fatal error; all interaction estimates finite
diagnostic_plan.proportional_hazards: Schoenfeld residual tests for interaction and global model; rank transform; alpha 0.05 descriptive only
diagnostic_plan.influence: interaction DFBETA flag |DFBETA| > 2/sqrt(n) and list top five absolute values; no automatic deletion
diagnostic_plan.reporting: n, events, beta, HR, 95% CI, P, PH diagnostics, influence flags, software and hashes for both classifiers

important_definition_note: The frozen 333-row set excludes six IDH1-WT rows containing literal 'NA' in at least one source-listed covariate; the deposited MGMT 'Missing' category is retained. This is a version-specific source-covariate availability rule, not a universal complete-case definition.
